notes:
Bugfix and stability release.

Fixed:
- Output window no longer yanks the view back to the bottom while you scroll up to read older logs. Auto-follow resumes when you scroll back to the tail.
- .gitignore no longer hides app-content.json and app-update.sample.json. Also fixed a typo that prevented obj/ from being ignored.
- RuntimeContentService now reuses a single HttpClient instead of creating one per request (avoids socket exhaustion).
- App update check no longer treats any non-numeric version difference as an update (was causing false update prompts for pre-release-style versions).
- Bootstrapper now launches the updated exe from the path it was originally started from.

Removed dead code:
- ThemeManager.HoverBrush and unused SetStaticAutoUpdateLogs / _setSettingMethod members.
- Duplicated WriteLog local functions in XenoApiAdapter consolidated into one helper.

Build/release tooling:
- WPF temp csproj no longer committed.
- app-content.json is only copied to output when missing, so builds don't clobber user edits.
- release.ps1 resolves gh from PATH with a fallback to the default install location.
